extracted.name: Gluten Free Pastry
extracted.description: This gluten-free pastry dough is easy to make with rice flour. Perfect for using in all your favorite pie and pastry recipes.
instruction_lines: Whisk rice flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder together in a bowl. Cut in shortening until the mixture resembles sand. Stir in water and vanilla extract until dough forms a ball.
Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate, at least 1 hour or up to 3 days.
